name: Hk-Clinics
description: A responsive single-page clinic website built for Dr. Hari Kishore Potupureddy in Visakhapatnam. Features interactive surgical case galleries, GSAP scroll animations, Google Maps integration, and seamless WhatsApp appointment booking. Built with Vite, modern CSS3, and Vanilla JS.

paragraphs: Clinic website for HK Advanced Joint Spine & Sports Clinics

Commissioned Freelance Project This repository contains the codebase for a single-page medical practice marketing website built as freelance client work for Dr. Hari Kishore Potupureddy, a fellowship-trained orthopedic & spine specialist in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. The code is presented here as part of a professional development portfolio. All clinic branding, medical descriptions, radiological images, case documentation, and doctor credentials are the exclusive intellectual property of the client.

This is a modern, high-performance, single-page marketing website designed to establish a strong digital presence for HK Advanced Joint Spine & Sports Clinics. The site showcases Dr. Hari Kishore's gold-medalist qualifications and international fellowships, tours the modern clinic and rehabilitation facilities, and presents an interactive gallery of real surgical cases and deformity corrections. It delivers a seamless patient experience by integrating a direct WhatsApp appointment request pipeline alongside local Google Maps navigation and verified reviews.
features: Responsive Single-Page Layout: Mobile-first design engineered for fluid performance across smartphones, tablets, and desktop displays.

Clinical Case Gallery & Media Suite: Showcases real surgical outcomes, including pre/post-operative radiological X-rays, deformity correction progress, and procedure videos with native playback controls and asset…
WhatsApp Deep-Link Appointment Booking: Interactive appointment request form that validates patient details and generates a pre-formatted, one-click WhatsApp message for clinic staff.
Interactive Google Maps Embed & Directions: Deep-linked navigation buttons and embedded map directly pinned to the clinic's MVP Colony location in Visakhapatnam.
Patient Testimonials & Reviews: Verified patient review carousel featuring touch/swipe gesture support, auto-rotation, and direct deep-links to Google Business reviews.
